description: Repo-local Renovate rules, merged after the ocx-sh/conventions preset. Ecosystem norms (npm, docker, actions, cargo, python) live in conventions; put only repo-specific rules here.

packageRules.description: external/ocx submodule bump — the ocx_* path deps advance with it; chore(deps) prefix
Action pins embedded in pipeline workflow templates — same actions group + ci(deps) prefix
ocx CLI pin for container test legs — not an action; must not join the actions group (rule order: this one wins)
Gate-script test toolchain (scripts/requirements.lock, uv pip compile) — its own group, chore(deps) prefix
Docs site toolchain (docs/requirements.lock, uv pip compile) — group, chore(deps) prefix

customManagers.description: Bump SHA-pinned GitHub Actions baked into pipeline templates (outside .github/, so the built-in manager never sees them)
Bump the ocx CLI release the container test legs download (a renderer constant, so no manager sees it)
